A Letter For You

Words from my heart

My dearest Sanju,

On this beautiful day that the world gifted us — the day you were born — I find myself overwhelmed with gratitude. Gratitude that you exist. That somehow, of all the people in this vast world, you chose me. I still can't believe I get to call you mine.

You are the warmest thing in my life. Your laugh is my favourite sound. Your presence is my favourite place. There is a kind of magic that only you carry — one that makes ordinary Tuesdays feel like the most important days of my life. You don't even try, and yet you make everything beautiful.

I love the way you care. I love your stubbornness. I love how deeply you feel everything. I love you in your happiness, in your silence, in your chaos, in your calm — in all the ways you are entirely, perfectly yourself. The world has never seen anyone quite like you, and it is so incredibly lucky that you're in it.

If I could bottle the feeling of being loved by you, it would be the most precious thing on earth. You are not just special to me — you are special, full stop. No conditions. No comparisons. You stand alone.

Today, on your birthday, I want you to know — you deserve every good thing. Every candle flame, every petal, every star in the sky tonight belongs to you. The universe made you, and the universe got it absolutely right.

Happy Birthday, Sanju. 🌹 I love you more than words ever could say — and I will spend every day for the rest of my life showing you that.

— Forever yours, Kundan 💕

He wrote this and hid it inside the games, just for you...

"
My Sanju,

I put this message inside these games because I wanted you to earn it.
Not because you don't deserve it — you deserve everything — but because
I wanted you to feel how I feel every day.


Every day, I do little things — small, invisible things — just to get to
the moment where I see you smile. That is my reward. That is my game.
And I play it every single day, and I win every single day,
because at the end, there's always you.


Today is your birthday. The world gave you to itself — and somehow,
impossibly, the world gave you to me too.


I don't have the words for what you mean to me.
I have tried. I write. I delete. I try again.
The words always come out smaller than the feeling.


So instead, let me just say this, very simply —


You are the reason I believe in good things.
You are the reason I wake up and think: today is going to be beautiful.
You are, Sanju — just entirely, completely —
the best thing that has ever happened to me.


Happy Birthday.
May every single day that follows this one
feel as loved as you have made me feel
every single day I have known you.

— Yours, always & only,
Kundan 💕
